narrative:
## Handover Summary — Contract Revenue & KPI Assurance

Billing triggers, indexation clauses and KPI credit exposure reviewed per contract.

## Key Decisions
• NLW clauses invoked and indexation talks opened on four council contracts (+GBP 3.5M FY2027)
• Change requests billed from the governed register (~GBP 6M cash forward)
• Activity matched to billing triggers weekly (~GBP 3M recovered)

signals.title: Delivery wage inflation only partly recovered
signals.excerpt: About £6M of the April 2026 National Living Wage and employer NICs increase is unrecovered; 62% passes through indexation clauses.
